newsitem.title: GERMANY: SVC-Metro says loss carry-over approved.
newsitem.headline: SVC-Metro says loss carry-over approved.

text.p: German retail group Metro AG said on Monday that the tax office had cleared the carrying forward of losses posted at SB-Kauf, one of the companies which was merged into the Metro group, which was listed last July.

Der Spiegel magazine reported that Cologne prosecutors were investigating possible irregularities linked to offsetting the losses against tax, which had been presented in the share issue prospectus as "a major advantage."
The Cologne prosecutors couldn't immediately be reached for comment.
Metro said in a statement that finance authorities had in May given their written agreement to SB-Kauf management on all points after investigating the company's finances.
In the bourse listing prospectus, Metro carried forward losses of 1.9 billion marks to be set against corporation tax.
"The Metro board sees no reason to correct statements it has made in the past on this subject," the statement said.
Metro shares had fallen sharply in pre-bourse trading on the Spiegel report, but at 1100 GMT were up 3.30 marks at 129.80 marks. That was still well below its stock market debut of 143 marks.
